_comment: Angels, the narrow Giada second main (USER 2026-10-14, MTG_ANGELS_GIADA_M2; docs/design/angels-cast-order-2026-10-14.md). The draft's probe 4-e: T3, Giada, Font of Hope in play (not sick), 2 Plains + a Plains in hand, hand Righteous Valkyrie + Lightstall Inquisitor. Main 1 casts Righteous off the three Plains and leaves Giada untapped; she attacks (vigilance keeps her untapped) and her post-combat Angel-only {W} pays Lightstall -- the only line that wins T5. With main 1 only, both casts need her mana before combat and she cannot attack: opponent at 2 after T5 (see angels_giada_m2_off_no_t5.json).
